subgroups.name: solve 1

steps.hints: ❓Which index values should be used inside the parentheses of the if conditional so the sound only plays if all three card images match?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ What index value accesses the third element in the displayArray?


Solution: 

displayArray[0].image should be changed to displayArray[2].image in the last instance, inside the parentheses of the if conditional.
steps.instructions:
When the A button is pressed, the magic wand sound is always played!


Fix the bugs in the code so that magic wand sound only plays when all three card images match.

let imageArray = [crystalBall, soda, cat, books]
let displayArray: Sprite[] = []

// game set up
scene.setBackgroundColor(7)

let xOffset = 40
let spacing = 36

for (let count = 0; count < 3; count++) {
    let cards = sprites.create(cardImage, SpriteKind.Player)
    cards.x = count * spacing + xOffset
    cards.y = screen.height / 2
}

// game events
controller.A.onEvent(ControllerButtonEvent.Pressed, function () {
    sprites.destroyAllSpritesOfKind(SpriteKind.Display)
    for (let count = 0; count < 3; count++) {
        let displaySprite = sprites.create(imageArray[randint(0, imageArray.length - 1)], SpriteKind.Display)
        displayArray.push(displaySprite)
        displaySprite.x = count * spacing + xOffset
        displaySprite.y = screen.height / 2
    }
    if (displayArray[0].image == displayArray[1].image && displayArray[0].image == displayArray[0].image) {
        music.play(music.melodyPlayable(music.magicWand), music.PlaybackMode.UntilDone)
    }
})

subgroups.name: solve 2

steps.hints: ❓What other statement should be included in the parentheses of the else if condition so that the powerUp sound plays if any of the 2 display sprite images match?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ What symbol should be used to check if 1 out of multiple conditions is true?

❓ Which 2 images are not checked for a match inside the parentheses of the else if condition?


Solution: 

A third statement should be added inside the parentheses of the else if condition: 


|| displayArray[1].image == displayArray[2].image
steps.instructions:
When the A button is pressed, the powerUp sound doesn’t always play when 2 images match.


Fix the bugs in the code so that the powerUp sound plays if any of the 2 images match.

subgroups.name: solve 3

steps.hints: ❓ Where should code be added to reset the displayArray each time the A button is pressed?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ Which symbols should be used to assign an empty array to the displayArray?


Solution: 

displayArray = [] should be added underneath the destroyAllSpritesOfKind function, inside the controller.A event.
steps.instructions:
When the A button is pressed, a “win” sound always plays even if none of the images on screen match. 


Fix the bugs in the code so that each time the A button is pressed, the displayArray is reset and a sound plays only if 1 or more on screen sprite images match.

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 4 of Purple Belt! In this level, you’ll learn more about arrays and array functions. You’ll build on your understanding of arrays in JavaScript by exploring functions that will help you access, modify, and join elements in an array. Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 4:

badges.title: Push It, Pop It, Join It, Concat It!
badges.description: Use several different array functions in JavaScript to access and modify the data stored inside an array.

badges.title: A String of Numbers
badges.description: Use the toString function to convert a number to a string

badges.title: Arrays All The Way Down
badges.description: Create a nested array in JavaScript.

badges.title: Joined at the Hip
badges.description: Use the join function to join all the elements of a string array into one string value.

badges.title: Together Forever
badges.description: Use the concat function to join two arrays together into one new array.

badges.title: Pop It Like It’s Hot
badges.description: Use the pop function to remove and return the last element from an array.

badges.title: Group Project
badges.description: Use the allOfKind function to create an array of all sprites of the specified sprite kind.
